correctionsAndLimits.correction: General translated conic: Ax²+Bxy+Cy²+Dx+Ey+F=0. A shifted circle needs linear terms.
For delta(6,3), t=.5 is half the segment, not .5 seconds/metres. With unit direction, a distance parameter has spatial units.
Perpendicular bisector n=r-q,d=n dot(q+r)/2. The original rotated normal describes the line through the two points.
Compare y with min.y/max.y and z with min.z/max.z. Initialize the actual point count; reject nonfinite inputs and define empty-box state.

Original uses row vectors. Adapt once to the existing series' column vectors; abs(A)*half-extents describes the affine image's exact box enclosure, not necessarily the tight AABB of the original mesh.
General planes are affine, not necessarily linear subspaces. Signed distances require division by norm(n) unless n is unit; normalize n and d together.
Newell's ordered polygon normal is not a general least-squares fit to an unordered point cloud. Check polygon order, enough points and nonzero area before normalization.
Area by cross-product magnitude is nonnegative; signed2D formula changes with winding. Compare absolute values consistently.
With origin v3, independent basis axes are v1-v3 and v2-v3. Dimension n-1 needs affine independence.
Four equations with three unknowns can be consistent; an on-plane point admits barycentrics. Projection alone does not verify coplanarity, and unsigned subtriangle areas lose outside signs.
Inradius r=2A/perimeter=A/semiperimeter. Circumcenter may lie outside an obtuse triangle.
Remove C++ trailing argument comma. Convexity checks do not replace finite/planar/simple-contour validation, and hole-bridging seams require suitable algorithms.
